verdict: Leads are coming in, but cost per lead rose sharply this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 129 leads at an average cost of $7.76 per lead, all through Meta — Google Ads had no activity this period. In the most recent 7 days, leads dropped 22.58% while cost per lead jumped 36.94% on only a 6% increase in spend, pointing to audience saturation in the single campaign carrying nearly all of your budget. Website sessions rose significantly this period, which is a positive signal, but your Google Business Profile activity fell sharply at the same time, meaning organic visitors are not converting into calls or directions the way they should be. We're refreshing the ad creative and audience targeting this week to relieve the saturation pressure, and the Google Business Profile will be addressed in parallel to capture the intent that is already arriving.
